about: A table shown a page at a time (`page 50`, U1c), as every renderer pages it. The rows are ordered first (conformance/table-order.json), then cut into pages of `size` rows. `pages` asks for page `page` of `count` rows: a page before the first is the first, one after the last is the last, and no rows is one empty page. It gives the page shown, how many pages there are, the first and last row shown (counted from 1; 0 and 0 for none) and the text between the bar's buttons, `from-to / count` or `0 / 0`, in plain digits. The first and previous buttons work when the page is not the first, the next and last when it is not the last. A table keeps its page when its rows come again, within the pages there are, and goes back to its first page when its order changes. `selected` gives the page that shows the row at place `at` of the shown order (counted from 0), which a table turns to when that row is selected.
